body:
I think none of the `git`, `hg` or `vcsh` modules need to be listed here? But in any case, this should be removed:
```suggestion
commit_hash_length = 7
```

`$version` doesn't need to be conditional with this preset.
```suggestion
format = '(with [$symbol$version ]($style))'
```

The preses is only supped to include version-related modules.
```suggestion
```

A new module was added since you created this PR.
```suggestion

[opa]
format = '(via [$symbo($version ]($style))"'
```
Because the whole thing is conditional?

The commit_hash_length setting certainly does not belong into this preset and I removed it.

While not a symbol, the git modules format seem to have text that would display, so I think the same reasoning applies, and it reasonably fits here.

As I mentioned in my comments, the repository modules shouldn't be included:
```suggestion
```

There's a few typos in this line, and it's missing a newline underneath.

They're fixed by https://github.com/starship/starship/pull/6031 and https://github.com/starship/starship/pull/6118 -- could someone take a look?
